value.rationale: The spherical octant is a canonical octahedral partition cell, and pure degree-three is a natural seven-dimensional harmonic measurement space. Its exact five-level spectrum gives optimal and worst energy concentration and an exact condition number; the two-dimensional maximizer versus unique alternating minimum is structural information not supplied by a generic matrix formula. It is a finite-dimensional complete natural spectral classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a routine recalculation of an already-covered theorem.
